The '''Moenia Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]], on the world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was used as the headquarters of [[Borvo]] the Hutt.<ref name="SWG:BA" />
